drinks.drink_brief_description: Sweet, creamy, and chilled espresso with a condensed milk twist.
drinks.drink_description: Our signature iced latte sweetened with rich condensed milk, mixed with freshly pulled espresso shots and chilled whole milk over ice cubes. Perfect for those who love a smooth, sweeter coffee kick.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Layered espresso and cold milk drizzled with sweet caramel syrup.
drinks.drink_description: Fresh espresso poured over cold milk and vanilla syrup, topped with a heavy drizzle of buttery caramel sauce. Served layered for a beautiful visual effect before you mix it.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Classic chilled espresso and milk infused with smooth vanilla flavor.
drinks.drink_description: A timeless classic. Dark, rich espresso balanced with cold milk and premium Madagascar vanilla syrup, served over ice for a crisp, refreshing, and fragrant morning pick-me-up.

drinks.drink_brief_description: The ultimate cold fusion of bold espresso and rich chocolate sauce.
drinks.drink_description: For the chocolate lovers. A decadent blend of premium dark chocolate fudge sauce, espresso, and cold milk, poured over crushed ice. It is a rich, dessert-like coffee experience.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Chilled espresso featuring cozy, nutty hints of roasted pistachio.
drinks.drink_description: An artisanal beverage combining a sweet, nutty roasted pistachio sauce with fresh espresso and cold milk. Gives a unique comforting aroma and pairs beautifully with coffee notes.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Crisp and deeply refreshing espresso shots topped with chilled water.
drinks.drink_description: Rich espresso shots pulled over ice and extended with chilled water. This process preserves the nuanced flavors of the coffee bean while offering a light, clean, and highly energizing drink.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Blended ice coffee bursting with creamy roasted hazelnut notes.
drinks.drink_description: A frosty, blended treat. Espresso, milk, ice, and premium hazelnut syrup run through a high-powered blender until creamy. Finished with a light crown of whipped cream.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Earthy green tea matcha layered over a sweet white chocolate base.
drinks.drink_description: A beautiful premium ceremonial green tea matcha whisked and poured over a layer of cold milk and melted sweet white chocolate sauce. Ideal for coffee drinkers looking to try something different.

drinks.drink_brief_description: Black tea infused with warming aromatic spices, milk, and ice.
drinks.drink_description: A lightly spiced, incredibly aromatic blend of black tea, cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger mixed smoothly with cold milk and poured over ice cubes. Balanced, exotic, and refreshing.
